units.source_text: 听完这些话，本来将发长彦的功劳全部揽到自己身上的两位武士脸色大变安，

en.t: After hearing this, the two warriors, who had meant to claim all of Kaminagahiko's credit for themselves, turned pale,

units.source_text: 立刻打断了发长彦的话，
若有其事的说：“一派胡言，

en.t: saying with an air of complete seriousness, "Utter nonsense.

units.source_text: 弄断食蜃人头颅的人是我们，

en.t: We were the ones who broke the neck of the mirage-eater,

units.source_text: 识破土蜘蛛诡计并杀了他的也是我们。”

en.t: and we were also the ones who saw through Tsuchigumo's scheme and killed him."
